# `srs container`

```text
Container grouping and membership commands

Usage: srs container [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list          List all containers, optionally filtered by containerType or membership role
  create        Create a new container (reads JSON from stdin)
  get           Get a container by ID
  update        Update a container (reads partial JSON patch from stdin)
  copy          Copy a container: shares the member records, forks only the anchor (derived-from)
  delete        Delete a container by ID
  delete-plan   What deleting these containers takes with them: the instances only they hold (no other container lists them, and no record that stays derives from them). `--apply` deletes them and the containers (srs-rust#1436)
  members       Member instance management
  validate      Validate container invariants
  resolve-view  Resolve a structured container view: root + ordered members + Composition-driven column spec + per-member display label (issue #254)
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON output (default)
          - yaml: YAML output
          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
          
          [default: json]

      --store <STORE>
          Storage backend override. By default the backend is inferred from the repository location
          
          [possible values: file, json]

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

      --container <CONTAINER_ID>
          Container scope: constrains list/create/delete to this container's membership; on `context record` it adds the record's arrangement subtree in this container

      --actor <ACTOR>
          Session actor for everything this invocation creates (RFC-046 `createdBy`): JSON `{"kind":"human|ai","id":"<non-empty>","name":"<optional>"}`. Defaults to the `SRS_ACTOR` environment variable; with neither, creations are unattributed. Host configuration only — a request payload never carries it. An invalid value refuses every creating command (`actor-invalid`); a corpus below dataModelRevision 9 refuses an actor session (`revision-too-old`) until `repo apply-migration --id rfc046-actor-provenance`. A `.srsj` migrated in memory on open refuses every write first (`migration-required-before-write`) until its migrations are applied

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## `srs container list`

```text
List all containers, optionally filtered by containerType or membership role

Usage: srs container list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --type <CONTAINER_TYPE>
          Filter by containerType

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON output (default)
          - yaml: YAML output
          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
          
          [default: json]

      --member <MEMBER_INSTANCE_ID>
          Return only containers where this instance appears in memberInstanceIds (or a child container's)

      --root <ANCHOR_INSTANCE_ID>
          Return only containers whose anchorInstanceId is this instance (RFC-043: roots are gone)

      --store <STORE>
          Storage backend override. By default the backend is inferred from the repository location
          
          [possible values: file, json]

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

          Session actor for everything this invocation creates (RFC-046 `createdBy`): JSON `{"kind":"human|ai","id":"<non-empty>","name":"<optional>"}`. Defaults to the `SRS_ACTOR` environment variable; with neither, creations are unattributed. Host configuration only — a request payload never carries it. ## `srs container members`
```

```text
Member instance management

Usage: srs container members [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list     List the container's arrangement: entries `{instanceId, depth?}` in order (RFC-043)
  outline  The derived outline: entries and document body with parent, depth and run (RFC-043)
  add      Add a member; appends at depth 0 unless --position / --depth / --before|--after|--into
  remove   Remove a member; its descendants are promoted one level
  move     Move an entry's run: --position/--depth (absolute), or one relative flag
  repair   Remove every entry whose instance no longer resolves (RFC-043 repair); re-attach orphans and loop breaks, and remove a container directory with no head (RFC-051 [R11])
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --format <FORMAT>

Defaults to the `SRS_ACTOR` environment variable; with neither, creations are unattributed. Host configuration only — a request payload never carries it. An invalid value refuses every creating command (`actor-invalid`); a corpus below dataModelRevision 9 refuses an actor session (`revision-too-old`) until `repo apply-migration --id rfc046-actor-provenance`. A `.srsj` migrated in memory on open refuses every write first (`migration-required-before-write`) until its migrations are applied

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
